title: Stressed TF out
text:
Stressed TF out. You must be looking at this and thinking “it’s perfect. A good size. Seems effortless to assemble” well you’d be insanely wrong.

I, too, thought this. I bought this thinking it would be set up in 2 seconds and holding all my veggies and fruits and bread.

It does, indeed, hold my fruit and veggies and bread but if AND ONLY IF you do not look at it or think about it or breathe too hard in its direction or exist near it.

Now I’m not the brightest bulb but the amount of stress and anger assembling this thing caused me had me seriously considering therapy. Was ready to end it all right then and there. It should have been quick to do and instead I literally spent the better half of 20 minutes trying to make it work. If ANYONE can reply and tell me what I did wrong, I’m all ears. I BEG YOU. This thing makes me want to cry at the thought of how easy it is for it to fall apart….I guess, that’s one thing me and this holder have in common.

Does it do it’s job? Yes, but at what cost?!
